newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit stays in range ahead of long weekend.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit stays in range ahead of long weekend.

text.p: The ringgit was rangebound in late Kuala Lumpur trading as players refrained from taking new positions ahead of the long weekend, dealers said on Friday.
Malaysia's financial markets are closed on Monday for the Hindu festival of lights, Deepavali.
The dealers said the ringgit traded in a very tight range throughout the day despite some ringgit/Sing dollar unwinding.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5204/13 a dollar against 2.5203/13 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Thursday. It was at 1.7994/14 per Singapore dollar against 1.7944/58.
The ringgit earlier high of 1.8048 a Singapore dollar.
"There is no active participation ahead of the weekend," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said.
Earlier, the ringgit retreated after attempting to break through the 2.5180 a dollar technical barrier on dollar shortcovering and commercial demand.
Dealers said some Japanese and U.S. funds were covering short dollar positions.
"There is big commercial demand at 2.5180/90 area. Dollar/ringgit is holding well at that level," said a dealer with an European bank in Singapore.
